baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three w-k-l forms at words 4, 16, and 17 are twice directed toward God, grounded by prior guidance at words 8-9, and paired with pledged patience over harm at words 10-13.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus partitions agency rather than suspending it: prior guidance supplies a traversable course, entrustment transfers the threatened outcome to a sufficient keeper, and patience restrains panic so the speakers can remain on course while injury presses against their settledness.

activation_trace.role: Handing a matter to another supplies the transfer of outcome while leaving the speakers responsible for their own response.
The one who sufficiently keeps and conducts an assigned matter supplies the competence of the entrusted endpoint.
Gentle indication toward a road or truth makes already-received direction the warrant for present entrustment.
An extended way that can actually be traveled turns guidance into an ongoing course rather than a merely held proposition.
Holding the self back from panic supplies the speakers' active task under pressure.
A disliked injury that prevents ease supplies the pressure against which course-keeping must occur.

changed_reading.before: The speakers simply say that they should trust God and tolerate mistreatment.
changed_reading.after: They reason from an already traveled history of guidance: outcomes are handed to the competent keeper, while their retained work is disciplined movement through injury.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated w-k-l cluster is repeatedly given the same directed endpoint, God, rather than being left as undirected dependence among the threatened group.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root inventory carries both constructive entrustment and a failed pattern in which people lean on one another until the matter is lost. Repetition plus the explicit endpoint concentrates reliance and blocks an equation of trust with reciprocal duty-shedding or helpless inertia.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal dependence that lets the matter be lost supplies the negative control against which the directed construction is read.
The incapable person who abandons his affair supplies a second passive shadow that the speakers' pledge of patience resists.
Deliberate dependence supplies the positive relation, with its endpoint fixed by the focus construction.
Sufficient guardianship makes the endpoint capable of receiving the matter without licensing human neglect.

changed_reading.before: Reliance could sound like passive dependence caused by weakness.
changed_reading.after: The verse redirects dependence away from mutual abandonment: all entrust the outcome to one sufficient keeper and therefore can persist in their own assigned stance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The perfect guidance verb at word 8 governs a plural path noun with a first-person plural possessive at word 9, before the renewed declarations of reliance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Guidance can name direction, manner, and lived course as well as indication, while the plural paths are concrete means of reaching. The completed prior act therefore reads as a gifted plurality of conducted histories that generates present confidence without requiring every speaker's route to be identical.

activation_trace.role: Direction, manner, and course enlarge guidance from information into a way of proceeding.
A gracious gift to one held in affection supplies the received quality of guidance, not a route self-manufactured by the travelers.
Multiple traversable means support reading the plural as lived routes toward an end.
Reliance becomes the present response to routes already received and traveled.

changed_reading.before: God gave the group one abstract piece of religious direction, so they now trust.
changed_reading.after: The group invokes its already-gifted, possibly differentiated courses as experiential evidence for renewed reliance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening movement out of darkness into illumination and a straight road gives the focus paths a directional field. The later blocking, bending, and straying language makes that field adversarial: patience under harm is now course-preservation against attempted rerouting.

activation_trace.role: Direction toward a road or truth anchors the contextual map back in the focus guidance verb.
A way available for traversal is the focus object whose continuity is at stake.
Passage to the outside supplies a real transition rather than static illumination.
Illumination supplies the newly visible field in which a path can be followed.
A straight road supplies the normative orientation of the opening movement.
Turning and diverting supplies an intentional force acting against travel.
Departure from straightness supplies deformation of the route itself.
Loss of guidance and intended direction supplies the end state that endurance prevents.

structural_cues: 14:1 uses a from-to-to progression, turning revelation into directed movement.
14:3 places active diversion from God's way beside the attempt to make it crooked.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exit, illumination, straightness, blocking, curvature, and straying; I infer that the focus harm functions partly as attempted rerouting. A live alternative is that the harm is abuse without a specifically cartographic function.

changed_reading.before: The speakers have been shown some paths and separately promise to endure injury.
changed_reading.after: They have been brought into a visible, traversable orientation, and their endurance keeps hostile pressure from blocking or bending that course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The call to remember divine days, the pairing of intense patience with gratitude as a condition for recognizing signs, and the remembered rescue through severe trial turn focus patience into a mnemonic faculty. It keeps prior guidance available as evidence when present harm would make the speakers forget their route.

activation_trace.role: Already-given direction is the past evidence that must remain cognitively available.
Bringing something back after absence supplies the retrieval operation by which past guidance bears on present injury.
Self-restraint under pressure supplies the receptive durability associated with recognizing historical signs.
Recognizing a benefit and its giver makes remembered deliverance evidential rather than merely nostalgic.
Release by separation supplies a concrete precedent of being brought through oppression.
A test that exposes the true condition supplies the severe setting in which remembrance and patience become diagnostic.

structural_cues: 14:5 moves from historical deliverance imagery to remembrance and then names signs for the intensely patient and grateful.
14:6 embeds remembered blessing and rescue inside a catalogue of oppression and trial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembrance, recognized benefit, rescue, trial, and patient receptivity; I infer that these make the focus's completed guidance clause a remembered warrant for current trust. Alternatively, 14:5 may only name an audience capable of seeing signs, not a causal memory process.

changed_reading.before: Patience is sheer duration after guidance has already done its work.
changed_reading.after: Patience keeps the history of guidance and rescue retrievable, so past direction can continue to govern action during fresh harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opponents demand an overpowering proof, while the messengers disclaim the ability to produce it except by divine authorization and immediately direct believers to rely on God. The focus then grounds that reliance in guidance already received. Trust marks the boundary between faithful witness and control of validating outcomes; it is not a substitute for evidence but a refusal to manufacture or command it.

activation_trace.role: A compelling proof supplies the demanded object that the speakers cannot place under their own control.
Bestowal without exchange supplies the asymmetry of divine favor behind the messengers' role.
Authorization supplies the explicit limit on the messengers' power to produce the demanded sign.
Reliance follows the admitted limit and supplies the stance taken where permission and outcome remain external.
Prior direction gives the focus reliance a positive warrant rather than leaving it in an evidential vacuum.
Transferring the matter supplies the response to an outcome the messengers may not compel.

structural_cues: 14:10 ends the opponents' speech with a demand for manifest authority.
14:11 answers with human limitation, divine authorization, and the same reliance formula that 14:12 resumes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a demand, inability, authorization, favor, and immediate reliance; I infer an agency boundary between testimony and controlled proof-production. The alternative is that reliance merely closes the speech without targeting the demand for control.

changed_reading.before: The messengers trust because they cannot answer the challenge.
changed_reading.after: They refuse the challengers' premise that fidelity requires command over proof and outcome: guidance warrants witness, authorization governs signs, and entrusted endurance governs the interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: The threat immediately after the focus offers expulsion or forced return, followed by promised settlement and an opening judgment. This specifies the harm as control of route and residence. Entrustment gives God the destination and resolution, while patience refuses the coerced reverse journey.

activation_trace.role: Constitutional inability to remain in one place supplies an exploratory image of harm as induced unsettledness.
A traversed route is the focus anchor threatened by forced exit and return.
Being made to pass outside supplies the coercive displacement arm of the threat.
Return after departure supplies the demanded reversal of the messengers' current course.
Dwelling in a home supplies a counter-outcome to forced displacement.
Judgment that resolves closure supplies an outcome entrusted beyond the messengers' own coercive power.

structural_cues: 14:13 presents an explicit either-or: leave the land or reverse into the persecutors' community.
14:14-15 answer displacement with settlement and a requested decisive opening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expulsion, forced return, settlement, and opening; I infer that the focus harm includes route coercion and that patience means refusing reversal. The alternative is that the focus harm is broader and the later threat only one escalation.

changed_reading.before: The speakers endure unspecified mistreatment while trusting in a general sense.
changed_reading.after: They entrust destination and adjudication to God while refusing to let expulsion or forced return erase the paths on which they have been guided.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later followers ask their powerful leaders to avail them, but the leaders confess that guidance was not theirs to give and that neither panic nor patience now provides an exit. This sharply limits the baseline: patience does not compel rescue. In the focus it preserves fidelity during actionable time because reliance is lodged in God and grounded in guidance, not because endurance itself controls the outcome.

activation_trace.role: A sufficient keeper supplies the endpoint that distinguishes the focus reliance from dependence on incapable leaders.
Lack of strength identifies those who had transferred agency upward to human leaders.
Following behind supplies the failed horizontal dependency structure.
The questioned capacity to suffice exposes whether the entrusted party can actually answer for the matter.
The leaders' conditional treatment of guidance shows that they were not an independent source of direction.
The breaking point of patience supplies one side of the scene's explicit failed contrast.
Self-restraint appears here after the actionable interval, demonstrating that the posture alone is not an exit mechanism.
The absence of any turn away from the situation supplies the stated failure of both reactions to create escape.

structural_cues: 14:21 stages a follower-leader appeal about who can suffice for whom.
Its final equivalence between panic and patience is explicitly bounded by the absence of any exit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed human sufficiency, derivative guidance, equalized panic and patience, and no escape; I infer that patience gains its focus function from endpoint, guidance, and actionable timing rather than intrinsic efficacy. Alternatively, the equivalence may apply only after final judgment and not qualify patience in ordinary life.

changed_reading.before: If the speakers remain patient, patience itself will get them out of harm.
changed_reading.after: Patience is fidelity, not leverage over results; its present value comes from guided action under a sufficient entrusted endpoint before the possibility of response closes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adversarial speaker later denies coercive authority, reduces his role to a call, identifies the hearers' answer, assigns blame back to them, and denies reciprocal rescue. This prevents reliance from becoming abdication: one may entrust outcome to God while remaining answerable for which call one answers and how one acts under harm.

activation_trace.role: Handing over a matter supplies delegated outcome without erasing the agent who performs the handing over.
Denied power and jurisdiction delimit the false leader's actual causal reach.
A verbal call that inclines a hearer supplies invitation without compulsion.
Answering speech supplies the hearers' owned response in the causal sequence.
Censure for a blameworthy act returns moral ownership to the responders.
The denied ability to answer a rescue cry exposes the failure of reciprocal salvific dependence.

structural_cues: 14:22 explicitly narrows causal authority to call followed by voluntary response.
The mutual rescue denial and redirection of blame keep agency with the responders.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-coercive invitation, response, blame, and failed rescue; I infer that the focus entrustment concerns outcome, not surrender of moral response. A live alternative is that 14:22 addresses final accountability without defining every worldly act of reliance.

changed_reading.before: Entrusting the affair might mean that the speakers no longer own their choices.
changed_reading.after: They relinquish control of outcome, not responsibility: trust and patience are precisely the accountable response they choose under a pressure that cannot compel their allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The good-word tree has a fixed base and continuing yield, the bad tree is removed whole and lacks settlement, and God stabilizes believers. These images add a stationary complement to the focus's paths: reliable movement requires an anchored orientation. Patience and reliance are the lived rooting that prevents hostile pressure from making the speakers directionless.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self supplies the focus posture capable of receiving the later stability imagery.
A foundational base supplies the fixed orientation from which continuing action can grow.
Continuance without displacement supplies the good tree's resistance to destabilization.
Removal in one piece from the base supplies the negative image of total loss of orientation.
Stable settlement names what the uprooted counter-image lacks.
Divinely caused strengthening links the botanical contrast to believers sustained in their stance.

structural_cues: 14:24-26 opposes a fixed base and recurring fruit to total uprooting and no settlement.
14:27 transfers the stability vocabulary from the image to believers and firm speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed base, uprooting, lack of settlement, and divine strengthening; I infer that the focus patience and reliance enact this rootedness while the paths enact movement. Alternatively, the tree image may concern speech and belief without specifying the mechanics of endurance.

changed_reading.before: Guided paths imply only forward movement through persecution.
changed_reading.after: The movement is possible because the speakers are rooted in a stable entrusted orientation; patience prevents motion from becoming uprooted drift.

context_deltas.mechanism: The subjected ship runs through broad water by divine command, while celestial bodies persist in their course. This materializes the focus relation between guidance, paths, and reliance: creatures move through provided systems and means under an order they do not author. Trust is navigational participation, not waiting without action.

activation_trace.role: Direction and manner anchor the navigation model in the focus guidance.
Traversable means anchor the provided routes in the focus plural.
Directing a thing toward a purpose supplies an enabling order that precedes the travelers' use of it.
A vessel moving in water supplies the concrete carrier through an otherwise unstable medium.
Flowing movement supplies actual progress rather than inert provision.
Expansive water supplies the large, uncontrollable field through which provided means operate.
Persistent exertion supplies continuity of motion within the given order.

structural_cues: 14:32 joins divine subjection, a usable vessel, running, broad water, and divine command in one causal sequence.
14:33 repeats the subjection formula and describes persistent celestial motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered vessel, movement, a broad medium, and persistent courses; I infer that the focus reliance is analogous to skilled movement through provided means. The alternative is that these verses only enumerate gifts to prompt gratitude.

changed_reading.before: Reliance means ceasing initiative and waiting for a route to resolve itself.
changed_reading.after: Reliance means moving through routes and instruments already made serviceable, while conceding that their encompassing order and final arrival are not self-authored.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah explicitly separates postponement from inattention and later denies that God will miss the promise made to messengers. Focus patience therefore acquires a temporal logic: continued harm and delayed resolution do not show that the entrusted matter has been dropped.

activation_trace.role: Sufficient keeping supplies the focus premise tested by an interval with no visible resolution.
Self-restraint supplies the human practice that spans the interval.
Inattention that leaves a matter outside awareness supplies the explicitly rejected reading of delay.
Deferral to a later time supplies the real temporal condition without implying abandonment.
A promise failing at its appointed time supplies the second explicitly rejected fear.
A spoken commitment that opens expectation supplies the future object carried through the delay.

structural_cues: 14:47 negates promise-failure specifically in relation to the messengers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit delay, denied inattention, promise, and denied failure; I infer that this is the temporal content of the focus patience under harm. Alternatively, the later statements may concern punishment and vindication specifically rather than every entrusted outcome.

changed_reading.before: Ongoing injury with no immediate relief could count against the claim that the matter is safely entrusted.
changed_reading.after: Patience inhabits the difference between postponement and neglect: the unseen interval tests reliance but does not itself refute the keeper or the promise.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a bodily, form-distant branch of h-d-y rather than its ordinary directional branch. It remains anchored in the focus's guidance, traversable paths, and reliance cluster, and it yields a coherent motion mechanism. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for guided dependence, not as the lexical gloss of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places guidance immediately before plural paths and surrounds both with repeated reliance, allowing dependence to be tested as a mode of movement rather than immobility.

activation_trace.role: A weakened traveler moving while supported on both sides supplies reliance as a gait that still advances.
A road available to be traversed keeps the bodily analogy tied to actual forward course.
Dependence supplies the support relation without requiring the traveler to stop moving.

changed_reading.before: Dependence and movement are opposites: reliance begins when the speakers stop advancing under their own weakness.
changed_reading.after: Reliance can be the supported gait by which weakness continues along a guided path; dependence changes how movement occurs rather than canceling it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the stone and mountain branches of s-b-r and connects them to a late material image of mountains being displaced. It remains anchored in the focus pledge to practice s-b-r over harm, while 14:46 supplies pressure measured by dislodgement. Render it as an exploratory material model of resistance, not as a claim that patience literally means mountain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The pledged s-b-r at focus word 10 is placed directly over inflicted harm, making the material durability branches available when the surah later imagines forces capable of moving mountains.

activation_trace.role: Thick stone and stony ground supply a compact image of resistance to wearing and displacement.
A mountain and its central mass enlarge that resistance into a stable body.
Departure from place or condition supplies the threatened displacement against which durability is measured.
A high solid mass supplies the contextual object whose movement marks the pressure's extremity.

changed_reading.before: Patience is only inward emotional calm while injury passes.
changed_reading.after: Patience can be pictured as mountain-like positional resistance: harm tests whether a guided stance can be displaced, not merely whether pain can be felt quietly.

strongest_changes: The demand-permission sequence in 14:10-11 makes reliance an agency boundary: the messengers witness and endure without claiming control over proof or outcome.
The failed dependencies in 14:21-22 show that patience is not an escape technology and entrustment is not abdication; endpoint, response, and timing remain decisive.
The expulsion-return threat in 14:13 turns harm into coerced rerouting, while settlement and opening clarify what is entrusted.
The delay and promise statements in 14:42 and 14:47 give patience a temporal logic in which postponement is not neglect.
summary.what_was_special: The focus tightly combines a threefold reliance root, already-completed guidance, plural possessed paths, pledged patience, and inflicted harm. Whole-surah context repeatedly tests that cluster through blocked roads, forced return, failed human sufficiency, rooted versus uprooted stability, provided navigation, and delayed fulfillment, allowing several distinct but anchored mechanisms to coexist.
remaining_uncertainties: The plural possessed paths may denote a shared set of ways rather than differentiated personal histories.
The equivalence of panic and patience in 14:21 occurs after the actionable interval has closed, so its qualification of worldly patience must remain temporally bounded.
The supported-gait and mountain models are branch-backed material analogies, not proposed lexical replacements for the ordinary focus senses.
The focus harm may include speech, social pressure, and physical displacement together; the packet does not force one exclusive form.
